issues.description: The problem specification requires a method named checkOrderReady() on SealSaloon (see UML and task description). The reference solution instead implements this behavior in a method named processOrders(), and does not provide a checkOrderReady() method. This name/signature mismatch between the specification and the solution can confuse students about the required method name and expected API.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the solution method processOrders() to checkOrderReady() (or add a public checkOrderReady() that delegates to processOrders()). Ensure the method name and signature match the problem specification and UML so students clearly see the expected API.

Prefer renaming processOrders() to checkOrderReady() to match the documented API and reduce student confusion.
